<!-- Adding or changing an instrument? Tick what applies. For anything else, delete the list. -->

- [ ] One folder in `instruments/`, with `entry.json`, `README.md`, `firmware/` and at least one picture
- [ ] `python3 tools/library.py check` shows no errors
- [ ] It builds with ESP-IDF 5.5.1 (`idf.py build` in its `firmware/`)
- [ ] Its simulator passes, if it has one (`tools/sim/run.sh`)
- [ ] `status` in `entry.json` says honestly where it has run: `simulator`, `board` or `played`
- [ ] I wrote it (or have the right to share it), and it is shared under GPL-3.0 (code) and CC BY-SA 4.0 (images and text)
